parts.text: Explain why poly(ethene) is described as saturated even though it is made from an unsaturated monomer.

rows.answer:

M2 the polymer has only single C–C bonds

parts.text: Explain the difference between addition polymerisation and condensation polymerisation.

rows.answer:
Explanation linking (one mark each)
M1 addition: monomers with C=C join, only one product
M2 condensation: monomers with two functional groups join
M3 a small molecule (water) is also formed

parts.text: Explain why the polymer made from propene has a methyl group on every other carbon atom.
